name: 2D Gaussian Projection with Covariance Stabilization
definition: Computes the 2D screen-space covariance matrix and its inverse for a 3D Gaussian splat, ensuring numerical stability by adding a small epsilon to the diagonal to guarantee positive definiteness.
summary: This method projects 3D Gaussians to 2D using local affine approximation and covariance stabilization to prevent singularities, differing from native 2D splatting by handling perspective-correct geometric transformation.
